name: Unclench
description: A quick check-in for jaw, shoulders, hands and forehead, with room to skip any step.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A five-step check-in for jaw, shoulders, hands and forehead, on Guided Pause.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Soften what feels easy and skip the rest.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Follow each step. It moves on by itself after a few seconds.
Press Next to skip a step, or Back to try it again.
tips: This is a break, not advice. Stop if anything feels uncomfortable, and skip any step.
